correctness.rationale: For exactly three binary information symbols with iid support draws (singletons each rate a=p1/3, pairs each b=p2/3, triple c=p3) and peeling-only recovery, independently enumerated all 128 present-support subsets and its iterative peeling closure for target A. The resulting survival event has 28 failure sets and expands exactly as 2u^3v^3w-u^3v^2w-2u^3v^2+u^3-2u^2v^3w+2u^2v^2+uv^2w, u=e^(-at),v=e^(-bt),w=e^(-ct). Unit-rate Poissonization and integration produce all seven rational terms of E; zero p1 gives infinite time because no peeling begins. For p3=0, exact rational reduction yields E2(x)=(5x^4-20x^3+25x^2-4x+12)/(x(x-3)(x-2)(x+2)). Independent rational arithmetic checked Q(x)=22079x^4-116237x^3+361684x^2-375052x+120000 and its strict convex lower certificate on x in [0,1], hence E2(x)>27921/10000. Exactly 24 copies of each singleton, nine of each pair and one triple give 100 columns and E=13700419/4906902<27921/10000. This proves degree-three necessity for any global finite-length symmetric optimum if one exists, without asserting that the witness is globally optimal.
